  SUBJECT: ECE 2125/ECE_2125 ELECTROMAGNETIC WAVES

  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               A vector field is given in Cartesian coordinates as F = 10a x + ya y + xz a z. Express the vector at      (4)  
  $$point P (x=2, y=3, z=4) in Cylindrical and Spherical Polar coordinates.$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1B)               Find the acute angle between the two vectors A = 2a x + ay + 3a z and B = ax - 3a y + 2a z by using       (3)  
  the definition of (i) the dot product; (ii) the cross product.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1C)               A 2-µC point charge is located at A (4, 3, 5) in free space. Find Eρ, Eφ, and Ez at P (8, 12, 2).         (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2A)               State and establish the divergence theorem in the context of electrostatics, relating to the integral     (4)  
  and differential forms of Gauss's law.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  $$the potential field V =(200/r) Volt.$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3A)               Given the field H = 6r sinϕ a r + 18r sinθcosϕ a ϕ , evaluate both sides of Stoke's theorem for the       (4)  
  portion of the cone θ = 0.1π bounded by r = 2, r = 4, ϕ = 0 and ϕ = 0.3π. Let the positive direction of  
  ds be aθ .  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

4A)     A uniform plane electromagnetic wave operates at a frequency f = 600 MHz and is propagating in a (4)  
  lossless dielectric medium with:  
  $$Relative permittivity εr = 4, Relative permeability µr = 9.$$  
  Given:  
  $$Permittivity of free space: ε =8.854\times 10-12F/m$$  
  0  
  $$Permeability of free space: µ = 4\pi  \times 10-7 H/m$$  
  o  
  Assume maximum electric field amplitude E0 = 200 V/m, polarized along x-axis, and propagation in  
  +z-direction.  
  Find:  
  i) The propagation constant ß.  
  ii) The wavelength λ.  
  iii) The equations of E(z, t) and H(z,t) fields.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
$$4B)     An H field in free space is given as H (x, t) = 10cos (10 8 t - ß x) ay A/m.                              (3)$$  
  $$Find: (a) ß; (b) \lambda ; (c) E (x, t) at P (0.1, 0.2, 0.3) at t =1 ns.$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)     With a suitable figure and the necessary equation, explain what is Skin Depth. Explain how the            (3)  
  depth of penetration is related to the signal attenuation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5A)     A 50 Ohm lossless line connects a signal of 110KHz to a load of 75 Ohms. The load power is 100            (4)  
  mW. Calculate the  
  (i) Voltage reflection coefficient  
  (ii)VSWR  
  (iii) Position of first Vmin and Vmax.  
  (iv) Impedance at Vmin and Vmax and the values of Vmin and Vmax.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)     A transmission line has the following parameters:                                                         (3)  
  $$R=5 ohm/m, G=0.5 mmho/m, f=1.5 GHz, L=8nH/m and C=0.23pF/m.$$  
  Calculate: (a) The characteristic impedance (b) Propagation constant.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)     Compare and contrast distributed and lumped parameter Transmission Line models, specifying the (3)  
  conditions under which each is applied and describing the relevant per-unit-length line parameters.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
